description: Angular component for string pattern autocomplete with overlay positioning, highlighting, and selection logic.

classes.name: StringPatternAutocompleteComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing a string pattern autocomplete input with overlay suggestions, highlighting, and keyboard navigation.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes form control, event subscriptions, and overlay setup.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles input property changes, updates highlight HTML and validators.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets the current value and updates highlight and form control.

methods.name: onFocus
methods.description: Triggers selection change logic on focus.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers change callback.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Placeholder for touch callback.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the component.

methods.name: onInputScroll
methods.description: Syncs scroll position between input and highlight.

methods.name: optionSelected
methods.description: Handles selection of an option, updates input value.

methods.name: openValues
methods.description: Opens autocomplete with predefined values.

methods.name: updateView
methods.description: Updates internal model and highlight HTML.

methods.name: onSelectionChange
methods.description: Handles selection change, filters options, and manages overlay.

methods.name: getHighlightHtml
methods.description: Generates HTML with highlighted pattern segments.

methods.name: getFilteredOptions
methods.description: Filters predefined values based on current input and pattern.

methods.name: openAutocomplete
methods.description: Creates and attaches overlay for suggestions.

methods.name: closeAutocomplete
methods.description: Detaches overlay and resets mode.

methods.name: getOverlayPosition
methods.description: Calculates overlay position strategy.

methods.name: setStrategyPositions
methods.description: Sets overlay position options based on input bounds and pattern index.

methods.name: setActiveOption
methods.description: Highlights active suggestion option.

methods.name: handleKeydown
methods.description: Handles keyboard navigation and selection within overlay.
